description: This file defines the NotesDatabase class, which provides an interface to manage notes stored in an SQLite database. It includes methods to initialize the database, add, retrieve, update, and delete notes, as well as ensuring the database connection is open.

classes.name: NotesDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class managing local SQLite database operations for notes.

methods.name: _ensureOpened
methods.description: Ensures that the database connection is established; opens the database if not already open.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from the database, ordered by pinned status and update date.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and returns its generated id.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database based on its id.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its id.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its id.
